name: Tournament FPS
tagline: Tournament baseline · eligibility first · measure the rest
description: A conservative starting lane for tournament PCs: display refresh, mouse mapping, Game DVR, sticky-key popups, and audio format. It does not enable Secure Boot, TPM 2.0, or IOMMU, and it does not certify anti-cheat eligibility. Device interrupts, boot flags, power-plan experiments, and stripped-OS changes stay out of this baseline; test those separately in Asta.
